newsitem.title: UK: Varig welcomes BA UK-Brazil cargo rate rise.
newsitem.headline: Varig welcomes BA UK-Brazil cargo rate rise.

text.p: Varig Brazilian Airlines is "surprised but pleased" that British Airways Plc has decided to increase its UK-South America cargo rates by 10 percent from March 17 but does not intend to follow suit in the near future, UK cargo manager Paul Ryan said.
"BA has always been cheaper than us on the UK-Brazil route, by up to 25-30 percent, because their strategy has been to develop new markets by offering low cargo rates," he told Reuters.
Ryan said that by bringing its rates up closer to Varig's, BA was suggesting that it had not been attaining sufficient yields on the route.
"In contrast, our UK-Brazil cargo yields have always been good and BA is agreeing that our rates must be in the right bracket," he said.
"Cargo rates in this market and others have been low enough anyway when airlines' investment in development and equipment is taken into consideration," Ryan noted.
He added that the UK-Brazil air cargo market was "strong enough" to support BA's planned cargo rates rise.
"In light of the BA move, I will review the rates situation. But at the moment I have no intention of raising rates on the route," he said.
--Bob Murphy, Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
